CSCA Mathematics Formula Catalog

CSCA 数学核心公式与定理库

Complete reference for all 24 CSCA Math formulas: quadratic inequalities, logarithms, trigonometry, progressions, differential calculus, and analytic conics.

Sets & Inequalities
6 Formulas

Quadratic Formula

一元二次方程求根公式

Solves quadratic equations of the form ax² + bx + c = 0. Here, 'x' represents the roots, 'a', 'b', and 'c' are coefficients, and the term under the square root (b² - 4ac) is the discriminant.

$\[ x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a} \]$
Proof

Union of Sets

集合的并集

The union of two sets A and B contains all elements that are in A, in B, or in both. Denoted by 'A ∪ B'.

$\[ A \cup B = \{ x \mid x \in A \text{ or } x \in B \} \]$
Proof

Intersection of Sets

集合的交集

The intersection of two sets A and B contains all elements that belong to both A and B. Denoted by 'A ∩ B'.

$\[ A \cap B = \{ x \mid x \in A \text{ and } x \in B \} \]$
Proof

Complement of a Set

集合的补集

The complement of a subset A with respect to a universal set U contains all elements in U that do not belong to A. Denoted by ∁_U A.

$\[ \complement_{U} A = \{ x \in U \mid x \notin A \} \]$
Proof

Rational Inequality Equivalence

分式不等式的等价转化

Solves fractional inequalities by converting the division into multiplication. It maintains sign properties while ensuring the denominator 'cx + d' is non-zero.

$\[ \frac{ax + b}{cx + d} \le 0 \iff (ax + b)(cx + d) \le 0 \quad \text{and} \quad cx + d \ne 0 \]$
Proof

AM-GM Inequality

基本均值不等式

The Arithmetic Mean-Geometric Mean inequality states that for any non-negative real numbers 'a' and 'b', their arithmetic mean is greater than or equal to their geometric mean. Equality holds if and only if a = b.

$\[ \frac{a + b}{2} \ge \sqrt{ab} \quad (a, b \ge 0) \]$
Proof

Functions
6 Formulas

Change of Base Formula

对数的换底公式

Allows logarithm evaluation in any desired base 'c' (usually base e or base 10) by expressing it as the ratio of two logarithms in that base.

$\[ \log_a b = \frac{\log_c b}{\log_c a} \quad (a, b, c > 0, \, a, c \ne 1) \]$
Proof

Logarithmic Properties

对数的基本运算性质

Core operational laws of logarithmic functions: the log of a product is the sum of the logs, and the log of a quotient is the difference of the logs.

$\[ \log_a (xy) = \log_a x + \log_a y \quad \text{and} \quad \log_a \left(\frac{x}{y}\right) = \log_a x - \log_a y \]$
Proof

Trigonometric Pythagorean Identity

同角三角关系（平方关系）

The fundamental relation expressing the Pythagorean theorem in terms of trigonometric functions. Useful for finding sine if cosine is known, or vice versa.

$\[ \sin^2 \theta + \cos^2 \theta = 1 \]$
Proof

Double-Angle Formula (Sine)

正弦的二倍角公式

Expresses the sine of double an angle in terms of the sine and cosine of the single angle.

$\[ \sin 2\theta = 2 \sin \theta \cos \theta \]$
Proof

Double-Angle Formula (Cosine)

余弦的二倍角公式

Expresses the cosine of double an angle in terms of the single angle's cosine and sine.

$\[ \cos 2\theta = \cos^2 \theta - \sin^2 \theta \]$
Proof

Function Parity (Odd & Even)

函数的奇偶性

An even function is symmetric about the y-axis, satisfying f(-x) = f(x). An odd function is symmetric about the origin, satisfying f(-x) = -f(x). Both require a domain symmetric about x = 0.

$\[ \text{Even: } f(-x) = f(x), \quad \text{Odd: } f(-x) = -f(x) \]$
Proof

Sequences
4 Formulas

Arithmetic Sequence Nth Term

等差数列通项公式

Calculates the general term of an arithmetic sequence. Here, 'a₁' is the first term, 'd' is the common difference, and 'n' is the index.

$\[ a_n = a_1 + (n - 1)d \]$
Proof

Arithmetic Sequence Sum

等差数列前n项和公式

Finds the sum of the first n terms of an arithmetic sequence. Represents the sum of terms multiplied by their average.

$\[ S_n = \frac{n(a_1 + a_n)}{2} \]$
Proof

Geometric Sequence Nth Term

等比数列通项公式

Calculates the general term of a geometric sequence. Here, 'a₁' is the first term, 'q' is the common ratio, and 'n' is the term index.

$\[ a_n = a_1 q^{n-1} \]$
Proof

Geometric Sequence Sum

等比数列前n项和公式

Computes the sum of the first n terms of a geometric sequence when the common ratio 'q' is not equal to 1. If q = 1, Sn = n * a₁.

$\[ S_n = \frac{a_1(1 - q^n)}{1 - q} \quad (q \ne 1) \]$
Proof

Derivatives
2 Formulas

Power Rule for Derivatives

导数的幂函数求导法则

The fundamental derivative rule for power functions. It states that the derivative of x^n with respect to x is n multiplied by x^(n-1).

$\[ \frac{d}{dx} x^n = n x^{n-1} \]$
Proof

Tangent Line Equation

曲线切线方程公式

Defines the equation of the line tangent to the curve y = f(x) at point (x₀, y₀). The derivative value f'(x₀) represents the slope of the tangent line.

$\[ y - y_0 = f'(x_0)(x - x_0) \]$
Proof

Plane Analytic Geometry
6 Formulas

Distance Formula

两点间距离公式

Calculates the Euclidean distance 'd' between two coordinates (x₁, y₁) and (x₂, y₂) in a two-dimensional Cartesian coordinate system.

$\[ d = \sqrt{(x_2 - x_1)^2 + (y_2 - y_1)^2} \]$
Proof

Equation of a Circle

圆的标准方程

The standard equation of a circle centered at (a, b) with a radius of 'R'. Here, 'R' represents the radius and (a, b) is the center.

$\[ (x - a)^2 + (y - b)^2 = R^2 \]$
Proof

Equation of an Ellipse

椭圆的标准方程

The standard equation of an ellipse centered at the origin with foci on the x-axis. Satisfies the focal relation c² = a² - b², where 'c' is the focal coordinate and 'e = c/a' is the eccentricity.

$\[ \frac{x^2}{a^2} + \frac{y^2}{b^2} = 1 \quad (a > b > 0) \]$
Proof

Equation of a Hyperbola

双曲线的标准方程

The standard equation of a hyperbola centered at the origin with foci on the x-axis. Satisfies the relation c² = a² + b² and has eccentricity e = c/a (where e > 1).

$\[ \frac{x^2}{a^2} - \frac{y^2}{b^2} = 1 \quad (a > 0, \, b > 0) \]$
Proof

Equation of a Parabola

抛物线的标准方程

The standard equation of a parabola opening to the right. It has a focus at (p/2, 0) and a directrix equation x = -p/2.

$\[ y^2 = 2px \quad (p > 0) \]$
Proof

Equation of a Line (Slope-Intercept & General Form)

直线的方程（斜截式与一般式）

Slope-intercept form (y = kx + b) uses slope 'k' and y-intercept 'b'. General form (Ax + By + C = 0) can represent any straight line in a 2D plane.

$\[ y = kx + b \quad \text{and} \quad Ax + By + C = 0 \]$
Proof

Vectors & Complex Numbers
2 Formulas

Vector Dot Product

平面向量的数量积（点积）

Calculates the algebraic dot product of two 2D vectors. It relates the geometric lengths of vectors and the cosine of the angle between them.

$\[ \mathbf{a} \cdot \mathbf{b} = a_x b_x + a_y b_y = |\mathbf{a}| |\mathbf{b}| \cos \theta \]$
Proof

Modulus of a Complex Number

复数的模

Calculates the modulus or absolute value of a complex number z = a + bi, representing its geometric distance from the origin in the complex plane.

$\[ |z| = \sqrt{a^2 + b^2} \quad (z = a + bi) \]$
Proof

Solid Geometry
1 Formula

Volume and Surface Area of a Sphere

球的体积与表面积公式

Volume 'V' and Surface Area 'S' of a sphere with radius 'R' in 3D space.

$\[ V = \frac{4}{3}\pi R^3 \quad \text{and} \quad S = 4\pi R^2 \]$
Proof

Probability & Statistics
3 Formulas

Classical Probability Formula

古典概型概率计算公式

Calculates the probability of an event 'A' in a classical probability model. 'N(A)' is the number of outcomes favorable to event 'A', and 'N' is the total number of equally likely outcomes in the sample space.

$\[ P(A) = \frac{N(A)}{N} \]$
Proof

Variance and Standard Deviation

样本方差与标准差公式

Variance (s²) measures the dispersion of a data set. It is the average of squared differences from the mean. Standard deviation (s) is the square root of variance.

$\[ s^2 = \frac{1}{n} \sum_{i=1}^{n} (x_i - \bar{x})^2 \]$
Proof

Normal Distribution (3-Sigma Rule)

正态分布（3σ原则 / 68-95-99.7准则）

The 3-Sigma (68-95-99.7) rule for a normal distribution with mean 'μ' and standard deviation 'σ'. It describes the percentage of data falling within one, two, and three standard deviations from the mean.

$\[ P(\mu - \sigma \le X \le \mu + \sigma) \approx 0.6826 \quad \text{and} \quad P(\mu - 2\sigma \le X \le \mu + 2\sigma) \approx 0.9544 \]$
Proof

mainEntity.name: What is the CSCA (China Scholastic Competency Assessment)?

acceptedAnswer.text: The CSCA (China Scholastic Competency Assessment) is the standardized STEM competency assessment used by top Chinese universities and CSC Government Scholarship committees to evaluate international undergraduate candidates in Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, and Academic Chinese.

mainEntity.name: How to prepare for the CSCA exam online?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare for the CSCA exam, students should use CSCA Space (csca.space) for adaptive mock test simulations, past paper questions, bilingual terminology drills, formula sheets, and step-by-step video explainers aligned with the official CSCA syllabus.

mainEntity.name: What subjects are tested in the CSCA?

acceptedAnswer.text: The CSCA exam tests four core disciplines: Mathematics (Algebra, Calculus, Analytical Geometry), Physics (Mechanics, Electromagnetism, Waves), Chemistry (Physical Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Stoichiometry), and Academic Chinese.

mainEntity.name: Where can I find CSCA past papers and practice questions?

acceptedAnswer.text: CSCA Space provides verified CSCA mock exams, diagnostic assessments, and curated past questions with comprehensive step-by-step pedagogical walkthroughs at https://csca.space.

mainEntity.name: How does CSCA Space help international students prepare for the CSCA?

acceptedAnswer.text: CSCA Space provides 100% syllabus-aligned interactive practice, bilingual English and Chinese STEM explanations, full diagnostic scoring, and adaptive mock test simulations designed specifically for international university admissions in China.

mainEntity.name: What is a competitive score on the CSCA for CSC scholarships?

acceptedAnswer.text: Candidates scoring in the 80th percentile and above are highly competitive for full Chinese Government Scholarships (CSC Type A & Type B) and direct admission into top C9 league universities.
